scope: Frozen171/CANN9.2.0/910C/TP8/DP2/EP16; K03 target M3/CombineV2, K01-K02 long prefill; no new device run

K02_OA_gate.mechanism: A different kernel may fuse OA/send layout or share a larger SMLA/inverse-RoPE/OA producer. The current API cannot emit that packet directly.
K02_OA_gate.formula: Per-window old pack+AllToAll minus1%period minus paired native OA increment. This mixes cohorts only as a conditional screening model;it is not a measured service saving or hard runtime bound.
K02_OA_gate.gate: A new implementation or source-supported schedule must provide a material net case;do not repeat stock permutations or benchmark hot single weights.

limits: Input timings are historical serial/profile observations, not new implementation trials.
112 rank windows are correlated and are not112 independent service experiments.
K01 four-carrier envelope is not a clock-aligned request/P90 recomputation.
K02 direct reference and OA gate are different cohorts and cannot be added.
